options.content:
## My Copilot Activity and Usage

This is a self-service dashboard showing your individual GitHub Copilot activity. Select your enterprise and GitHub username from the dropdowns above.

Data has a 2-day lag — today's view reflects activity up to 2 days ago. The username dropdown is populated from the exporter daily data and requires no IT configuration.

**Sections**
- **My Summary** — headline activity numbers for the selected window
- **Daily and Weekly Activity** — prompt count, AI credits, and LOC trends
- **Model and Feature Breakdown** — which models and surfaces you use most
- **Code Output** — LOC suggested vs accepted and acceptance rate over time
- **My Daily Log Records** — structured daily Loki records with all available fields
- **IDE Usage** — which development environments you use Copilot in

**About the budget gauge:** Set your monthly AI credit allocation in the Monthly AI Credit Budget field. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Standard model usage does not consume AI credits and will show 0 on credit panels.

panels.title: Active Days
panels.description: Number of days you used at least one Copilot feature in the selected window. Source: count of github_copilot_user_daily_record data points for your username.

panels.title: Total Prompts
panels.description: Total Copilot prompts and interactions you triggered across all surfaces in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count.

panels.title: Lines of Code Added
panels.description: Total lines of AI-generated code you accepted into your codebase in the selected window. This is the primary output productivity signal. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum.

panels.title: AI Credits Used
panels.description: Total AI credits you consumed in the selected window. AI credits apply to premium model requests only. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used.

panels.title: My Adoption Phase
panels.description: Your current AI adoption phase as assigned by GitHub. No Cohort means no recent usage. Phase 1 is early adoption. Phase 2 is regular usage. Phase 3 is sustained multi-feature engagement. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_adoption_phase.

panels.title: Monthly AI Credit Budget Used
panels.description: AI credits consumed in the last 30 days as a percentage of your entered monthly budget. Green means within budget, amber means approaching limit, red means over 90% consumed. Set the budget using the field at the top of the dashboard.

panels.title: My Daily Prompt Count
panels.description: Number of Copilot prompts you submitted each day. Gaps indicate days with no usage. Spikes typically correspond to heavy feature development or debugging sessions. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count.

panels.title: My Daily AI Credits Used
panels.description: AI credits consumed each day. Credits apply only to premium model usage. Days showing zero may indicate standard model usage rather than no Copilot activity. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used.

panels.title: My Weekly Prompts
panels.description: Total prompts per week across the selected window. Use this to identify high-usage weeks and understand which projects drove the most Copilot activity. Source: github_copilot_user_prompt_count aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Weekly LOC Added
panels.description: Total lines of AI-generated code accepted per week. Combine with weekly prompts to calculate LOC per prompt — a rising ratio means each prompt is generating more usable code. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Weekly AI Credits
panels.description: Total AI credits consumed per week. Useful for tracking spend trends against billing cycles and identifying unusually expensive weeks. Source: github_copilot_user_ai_credits_used aggregated weekly.

panels.title: My Prompts by Model
panels.description: Distribution of prompts across models in the selected window. If premium models dominate for routine tasks, switching to standard models would reduce AI credit consumption without impacting output quality. Source: github_copilot_user_model_feature_prompt_count grouped by model.

panels.title: My Prompts by Feature
panels.description: Distribution of prompts across Copilot features (completions, chat, code review, CLI). Shows how you use Copilot across different surfaces and which you rely on most. Source: github_copilot_user_feature_prompt_count grouped by feature.

panels.title: My Top Languages by LOC Added
panels.description: Top 10 programming languages where you accepted the most AI-generated code. Reflects where you are getting the highest output value from Copilot. Source: github_copilot_user_language_feature_loc_added_sum grouped by language.

panels.title: LOC Suggested vs LOC Accepted
panels.description: Daily comparison of lines of code suggested by Copilot against lines you accepted. The gap between the two lines shows how selective you are with suggestions. A narrowing gap means you are accepting more of what Copilot offers. Source: github_copilot_user_loc_suggested_to_add_sum and github_copilot_user_loc_added_sum.

panels.title: My Code Acceptance Rate Over Time
panels.description: Daily ratio of code acceptance activities to code generation activities. A rising trend means you are accepting a higher proportion of AI suggestions over time, indicating improving prompt quality or better model fit. Source: github_copilot_user_code_acceptance_activity_count / github_copilot_user_code_generation_activity_count.

panels.title: My Daily Activity Log
panels.description: Structured daily log records for your user from Loki. Each row represents one day of Copilot activity. Expand a row to see all parsed fields including ai_credits_used, prompt_count, loc_added_sum, totals_by_model_feature, totals_by_feature, CLI token usage, and adoption phase. Source: Loki copilot_exporter stream filtered to your username.

panels.title: My Prompts by IDE
panels.description: Breakdown of your Copilot prompts by IDE over the selected window. Shows which development environment you use most with Copilot. Source: github_copilot_user_ide_prompt_count grouped by ide.

panels.title: My LOC Added by IDE
panels.description: Lines of AI-generated code accepted per IDE. If you use multiple IDEs, this shows where Copilot is delivering the most code output for you. Source: github_copilot_user_ide_loc_added_sum grouped by ide.
